45:t_1:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「You rascal! Have you been well?!」

45:t_1:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Look who's talking! I never thought we'd meet again like this!」

45:t_1:6.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Seriously. And we haven't even found $$ジャミル$$ and the others yet.」

45:t_1:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Huh...! $$ジャミル$$ and $$ウィッツ$$ and the others aren't with you?」

45:t_1:9.en:
$$パーラ$$
「After the fight with $$インサラウム$$ ended, we went back to our own Earth, and right away got caught up in a $$時空震動|lc$$.」

45:t_1:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「When I came to, $$ティファ$$, $$パーラ$$ and I were in this $$残されの海$$. That's how it went.」

45:t_1:12.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's what they call the whole sea around here. I have no idea why it's called that, though.」

45:t_1:13.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You can ask the Fleet Commander about that.」

45:t_1:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, you guys! Thanks for helping us out earlier.」

45:t_1:15.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ガロード$$... Who are they?」

45:t_1:16.en:
$$ガロード$$
「They're from the $$ガルガンティア船団$$. The people I work for, like I told you earlier.」

45:t_1:17.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I'm $$ベローズ$$. I do salvage work.」

45:t_1:18.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Name's $$ピニオン$$. I'm a repairman.」

45:t_1:19.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「So, $$ガロード$$... I get why you're excited to see old friends again, but first you're going to finish your job.」

45:t_1:22.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Exactly. One of my crew found an interesting treasure around here.」

45:t_1:23.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It's sunk in a bit of a tricky spot, so I want to borrow the power of $$ガロード$$'s $$ダブルエックス$$.」

45:t_1:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ガロード$$, are they making you help with their treasure hunt?」

45:t_1:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's not all. Guarding against pirates, helping with the fishing, loading and unloading cargo, fixing ships...」

45:t_1:26.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It reminds me of when I went off to work for $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.」

45:t_1:27.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Your $$ダブルエックス$$ is a good machine, after all.」

45:t_1:28.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「So, sorry to you guys over there, but I'll have to guide you to the fleet after the job is done.」

45:t_1:29.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're the ones who drove off the pirates, so we owe you. The least we can do is treat you to a meal.」

45:t_1:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「We appreciate it. We'll be in your care for a little while.」

45:t_1:31.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you like, we can help with the treasure hunt too.」

45:t_1:34.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Let's go, $$ガロード$$. The treasure's waiting for us.」

45:t_1:36.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Well then, everyone. See you later.」

45:t_1:39.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「No, it's nothing. ...Anyway, I'll let $$ガルガンティア$$ know about you, so I'd like to meet your representative here.」

45:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
($$翠の地球$$... a green ocean, huh...)

45:t_1:42.en:
$$甲児$$
(Even if the sea is a slightly different color, it's the same Earth.)

45:t_1:43.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(Just you wait, $$サイデリアル$$. I'll drive every last one of you off this planet, I swear.)

45:t_10:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That voice... Are you the pilot of the blue robot that backed me up?」

45:t_10:6.en:
$n
「Yeah, that's right. ...I'm $F. Nice to meet you.」

45:t_10:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm $$ガロード・ラン$$. Nice to meet you too.」

45:t_10:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry, but I'm kind of busy right now. If you need something, keep it short.」

45:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I want to ask you about that weapon called the $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

45:t_10:11.en:
$n
「When you used that weapon, you called on the enemy to pull back. What was that about?」

45:t_10:12.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It meant just what I said.」

45:t_10:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's not like that. ...It's just that, if I can help it, I don't want to use the $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

45:t_10:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Having a weapon that's too powerful never leads to anything good.」

45:t_10:17.en:
$$ガロード$$
「There are times when you can't afford to talk pretty... But even so, I'd rather not use it.」

45:t_10:19.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's fine. Your backup helped me out a lot.」

45:t_10:20.en:
$n
「If you're saying that, then it goes both ways.」

45:t_10:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See ya. Let's have a proper talk later.」

45:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's just like a $$スフィア$$, isn't it.」

45:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those words from $$ガロード$$ seem to have left a strong mark on you.」

45:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hiding it is useless. When $$ガロード$$ fired the $$サテライトキャノン$$, a strong emotion was born in $n's heart.」

45:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That shock produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. Naturally, I've added them to the unit's stock.」

45:t_10:29.en:
$n
「...Hey, AG... Was the $$ジェニオン$$ built to steal the $$スフィア$$ of 《$$ジェミニア#keyword$$》?」

45:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I can't say for certain. But that is what I believe.」

45:t_10:31.en:
$n
「According to that guy $$ブルー$$, there are $$スフィア・リアクター$$s on this $$翠の地球$$...」

45:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I hear Miss $$セツコ・オハラ$$, whom the $$ギルター$$ we fought today mentioned, is also a Reactor.」

45:t_10:33.en:
$n
「AG... Look into the $$スフィア$$ as much as you can.」

45:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. But to draw out that power...」

45:t_10:36.en:
$n
「To draw out the power of the $$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$, the $$いがみ合う双子$$, conflicting human emotions have to act as the trigger...」

45:t_10:37.en:
$n
「I'll try. I don't know what to do right now, though...」

45:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe $n can surely master the $$スフィア$$ without being swept away by an overly powerful force.」

45:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, to lift our spirits, let's go! Another day of giving it my all...!」

45:t_10:41.en:
$n
「Sorry... That's the one thing I just can't bring myself to say.」

kept_omissions: none kept deliberately; subjects restored from scene (e.g. 45:t_1:29 Pinion 'we owe you', 45:t_10:14 Garrod 'I don't want to use it')
uncertain: ダブルエックス has no glossary token (only ガンダムＤＸ = Gundam DX); written as plain 'Double X' in 45:t_1:23 and 45:t_1:27
45:t_1:29 Pinion: 恩人 rendered as 'we owe you' (benefactors)
45:t_1:13 船団長 = 'Fleet Commander' (assumed, matches Gargantia sub usage)
45:t_10:6 $F left as game code after 'I'm' (assumed to be the protagonist's surname/call name)
45:t_10:25/27 AG's ガロード様 dropped to plain token (honorific rule); セツコ・オハラ嬢 kept as 'Miss'
45:t_10:36 『いがみ合う双子』 brackets dropped (ASCII-only rule), token used as in dlg_2002 'Quarreling Twins'
45:t_1:10 『残されの海』 brackets dropped, keyword token $$残されの海$$ used (glossary English is 'proposed')
45:t_10:40-41 AG's cut-off 'Another day of giving it my all...!' assumed to lead into his business catchphrase ('business, business!' per dlg_2200 765); Hibiki refuses to say it
45:t_10:31 and 45:t_10:32 use plural suffix 's' after $$スフィア・リアクター$$; 'Reactor' plain for bare リアクター in 45:t_10:32
Jigoku English reused for 45:t_10:3, 45:t_10:16, 45:t_10:24, 45:t_10:26, 45:t_10:35, 45:t_10:39 (identical Japanese) - note 45:t_10:24 Jigoku uses the token $$ＡＧ$$ as 'AG'; I used it verbatim
